title: Lessons on Impact of Tuberculosis Screening on Business Prospects at High Footfall Locations from Recent Exercises at Bedok
what_it_is: Lessons on Impact of Tuberculosis Screening on Business Prospects at High Footfall Locations from Recent Exercises at Bedok

sections.label: Communication with residents in operations
sections.summary: Clear communication with residents is a key success factor for such operations, though residents were largely appreciative of efforts to keep them safe.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: A key success factor for such operations is clear communication with residents, notwithstanding that residents were largely very appreciative of the efforts to keep them safe.

sections.label: Rebates for hawkers and tenants
sections.summary: Measures to minimise disruptions to businesses and the community included rental and service and conservancy charge rebates for eligible hawkers and tenants.

sentences.text: Further, measures will need to be taken to minimise disruptions to businesses and the community.
Hence, eligible hawkers and tenants also received rental, and service and conservancy charge rebates to mitigate the temporary impact on their businesses.

sections.label: Timeline and regime for screening
sections.summary: The 13 genetically similar cases occurred over three years, and the member asks whether a longer screening timeline or differentiated regime could be considered.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The impression that was created, in my view, suggested one of urgency and criticality, but the very act which triggered the exercise, the identification of 13 cases with genetic similarities, occurred over a period of three years from January 2023 to February 2026.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: So, does the Senior Minister of State not agree that in future, perhaps, a longer timeline for a screening exercise, or a differentiated regime for hawkers on the one hand and residents who may have transited through those areas where there is concern about a TB outbreak, could be considered?

sections.label: CDA precautionary screenings
sections.summary: CDA will have to do precautionary screenings, in this case for TB, on a regular basis when needed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: First, like I said in my earlier reply, CDA will have to do such precautionary screenings, in this case, for TB, on a regular basis, when needed.

sections.label: Genetically linked TB cases
sections.summary: CDA explained the 13 cases spanned three years, and whole genome sequencing tracked genetically linked TB bacteria across 13 individuals, none from hawkers, merchants or Heartbeat@Bedok or Bedok Town workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: CDA has also explained that the 13 cases were over a period of three years, but recent developments in whole genome sequencing, whole genome sequencing capabilities, they were able to track that the TB bacteria was genetically linked across 13 individuals – although none of them were from the hawkers, merchants or people working in Heartbeat@Bedok or in the Bedok Town.

sections.label: Improving public communications
sections.summary: CDA will see how to better improve public communications to assure people, and lessons learned will be incorporated into standard operating procedures.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: CDA will see how to better improve the public communications to assure people.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: These are lessons we have learned and we will make sure that those lessons would be incorporated in our standard operating procedures in our approach next time.
